payload.title: Simulated-stakeholder build and live runs on the chosen dataset (R4-R7)
payload.description:
## Purpose

Build and run the simulated-stakeholder experiment on the dataset the owner picks after R3: a stakeholder LLM holding the real full guideline explains Jev's errors against gold labels; the flywheel (feature discovery from explanations + optimized fixed few-shot list) starts from the one-line rubric S. Tasks R4-R7.

## Arms

labels-only; simulated-stakeholder explanations; SHUFFLED explanations (attached to wrong items: shows content matters); noisy stakeholder (~20% vague/wrong); start = S; F = ceiling.

## Metric

Fraction of the S-to-F gap recovered over rounds (macro-F1), and number of explanations needed; paired bootstrap CIs. If F does not beat S, report the gap relative to the human ceiling / supervised baseline instead and say so.

## Cost

R4/R5 $0 (offline). R6 + everything else in the initiative: cap ~$10 total.

## Definition of done

R7 published with caveats.
